name: PLATO Large SOCP Benchmark
description: Benchmarks second-order cone programming (SOCP) solvers on 18 large instances from the CBLIB (Conic Benchmark Library), covering structural beam optimisation, signal processing, and filter design problems. Problem dimensions reach up to 1.97 million rows and 121 million nonzeros. Solvers are compared on solution time and number of instances solved within a 1-hour limit.
typical_sota_score: COPT (1.0s geometric mean, 18/18); MOSEK (1.35s, 18/18); Knitro (7.94s, 17/18); ECOS (128s, 11/18).
reputation: Authoritative SOCP benchmark maintained by Hans Mittelmann; instances represent real-world engineering optimisation problems.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Problems from CBLIB. Instances include structural engineering (beam7, beam30) and signal processing (firL1) problems.
